character.name: Elen
character.starting_goal: document the lantern response while keeping the sealed causeway inaccessible
starting_relationships: Keeper Oren teaches Elen lantern handling.
Village elder Mira insists that closed paths remain closed until inspected.

world.habitat: peatlands, reflected waterways, stilt houses and a sealed causeway
world.technology_level: oil lanterns, footbridges, guide permits and ferries
world.magic_level: rare lantern echoes show prior footsteps but cannot certify present safety or motive
world.summary: Mirror Marsh contains causeways that can sink seasonally. Lanternkeepers record anomalous reflections but are forbidden to declare closed paths safe without repeatable outside surveys and authorized escorts.
social_context: Guides need escort authorization for a sealed causeway.
A lantern reflection records traces but cannot identify who walked recently.
An uncertain path must remain posted as closed.
known_pressures: The route is briefly illuminated despite being shut.
Villagers need a truthful warning before the next tide.
